original: A stress fracture ended my sophomore cross country season three weeks before regionals, and I spent that fall watching from the sideline in a walking boot.
polished: A stress fracture abruptly ended my sophomore cross country season three weeks before regionals, relegating me to watching from the sideline in a walking boot.

original: It was miserable in a way that's hard to explain to people who don't run.
polished: This experience proved genuinely difficult to convey to individuals unfamiliar with running culture.

original: My coach had me keep a training log anyway, just writing down how I felt each day, even doing nothing.
polished: Nevertheless, my coach insisted I maintain a training log throughout, documenting how I felt each day, even during periods of complete inactivity.

original: When I finally raced again that spring I was slower than I'd ever been.
polished: When I finally returned to racing that spring, I was slower than I had ever been.

original: I finished dead last in my first meet back and felt more proud crossing that line than I had at any race before the injury.
polished: I finished dead last in my first meet back, yet felt more genuine pride crossing that finish line than at any race preceding my injury, a powerful testament to perseverance.
